This App Connector version provides the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released for App Connector that includes bug fixes, optimizations, and version enhancements.
In the App Connector details drawer, the Host Platform field indicates when you are using a ZPA appliance.

Support for editing Local OS Network Settings at the group level and performing remote commands is available. This includes control of routes, DNS, SSH service, and other network settings. To learn more, see Network Settings Configuration for App Connectors.

Support for selecting an App Connector that is closest to the application when configuring application segments that include UDP ports is available. To learn more, see Closest App Connector to UDP Applications Available in App Segments.
Improved the reliability when calculating the round-trip time (RTT) to determine the UDP value for a health check. To learn more, see Configuring Defined Application Segments.
